name: 塞尔曼·瓦克斯曼
bio_short: 乌克兰裔美国微生物学家，诺贝尔奖得主。他创造了“抗生素” (antibiotic) 一词，并领导团队发现了链霉素（`waksman_streptomycin_1943`），这是人类历史上第一种能有效治愈肺结核的药物。
bio_short_en: A Ukrainian-born American microbiologist and Nobel laureate. He coined the term 'antibiotic' and led the team that discovered streptomycin (`waksman_streptomycin_1943`), the first drug in history capable of effectively curing tuberculosis.
